title: RGS Tool Autoinvoke — Per-roadmap-unit toolchain enrichment + outcome feedback loop
brief: Attach a self-correcting PRISM toolchain (dev pipeline + tribal + skills + MCP tools + review agents) to every open roadmap unit, surfaced at pickup, learning from shipped/blocked outcomes.

units.title: Hardened design spec + allowlist unblock
units.description: 10-agent pre-build scrutiny review of architecture. Key findings: compose-not-rebuild, fold-into-pick-prefresh, graph-load-once, promote feedback loop to MS0.

units.title: 10-task TDD implementation plan
units.description: Ordered build plan with test-first discipline for all 10 build units.

units.title: scripts/lib/system-viz-graph.mjs — loadGraph/findInGraph, load-once cache
units.description: Shared graph lib with mtime-keyed cache. Converts 4.3h cold-load to 3.4s on re-use. Used by planner, fusion, and surface hooks.

units.title: ollama-hook-bridge.mjs additive format passthrough
units.description: Additive format field passthrough in OllamaHookBridgeEngine enabling structured JSON output from qwen2.5-coder:7b for fusion synthesis.

units.title: scripts/lib/rgs-unit-enum.mjs — open-unit enumerator
units.description: Enumerates 4,404 open roadmap units by joining milestone envelopes with MILESTONE_PROGRESS status. Filters to not_started + in_progress.

units.title: scripts/lib/rgs-pipeline-rules.mjs — keyword→pipeline+agent rule table
units.description: The sole net-new knowledge artifact. ~30 keyword clusters mapping unit keywords to recommended pipelines + agent roles covering build/test/dispatcher/hook/schema/CAD/CAM/WEDM/lathe/mill/post/quote/ERP/memory/UI/docs.

units.title: scripts/lib/rgs-signal-fusion.mjs — pure fuser, minimum-plan contract, Beta re-rank
units.description: Pure signal fusion combining capability search + skill triggers + graph hits + tribal + rules. Minimum-plan contract ensures every unit gets at least a baseline plan. Beta distribution re-ranks tools using outcome history.

units.title: scripts/rgs-tool-planner.mjs — detached batch orchestrator
units.description: Detached batch orchestrator reading open units, running signal fusion, writing JSONL checkpoints (atomic flush), with file lock preventing concurrent runs. Resumes from checkpoint after interruption.

units.title: Feedback loop — rgs-plan-outcome.mjs + rgs-outcome-record-stop.mjs Stop hook
units.description: Outcome extractor reads session transcript to classify ship/block/abandon. Stop hook appends to roadmap-tool-plans.json outcome log. Signal fusion reads outcomes for Beta re-rank. Wired in both settings.json.

units.title: pick-prefresh-inject.mjs extended — tool-plan surfacing, no new hook
units.description: Extended pick-prefresh-inject to surface tool-plan recommendations at /pick-unit and /rgs pickup. No new hook — folded into existing inject per scrutiny recommendation.

units.title: scripts/rgs-plan-coverage.mjs — anti-rot %-fresh dashboard + /rgs tool-plan op
units.description: Anti-rot coverage dashboard reporting % of open units with fresh tool-plans (age < PRISM_RGS_PLAN_STALE_DAYS). Wired as /rgs tool-plan-coverage op. Healthy target: fresh_pct >= 80.

units.title: 5-surface doc reflection + milestone envelope
units.description: Wiki entry (knowledge/wiki/architecture/rgs-tool-autoinvoke-ms0.md), CLAUDE.md pointer, MEMORY.md line, Obsidian memory (reference_rgs_tool_autoinvoke_ms0_2026_05_16.md), settings.json grep verification, milestone envelope + state regen.

exit_conditions: All 12 units shipped with committed SHAs
rgs-outcome-record-stop wired in both settings.json (verified 1/1 each)
notes: 10-agent pre-build scrutiny review hardened design before first line of code. Key architectural decisions: compose-not-rebuild (only rule table is net-new), fold surfacing into existing pick-prefresh-inject hook, graph-load-once lib, feedback loop promoted from MS1 to MS0.
